# FirstShowing.net

> > FirstShowing.net is a film news and entertainment website covering movie trailers, casting news, production updates, and exclusive content from major studios and filmmakers.

The site provides comprehensive coverage of Hollywood productions, indie films, and international cinema, featuring breaking news about directors like David Cronenberg and Paul W.S. Anderson, actors including Jason Statham and Viggo Mortensen, and studio releases from Focus Features, Universal, and Legendary Pictures. FirstShowing.net serves as a destination for movie enthusiasts seeking early information about upcoming releases, remakes, and industry deals.

## Key Topics

- Movie trailers and previews
- Casting news and rumors
- Film remakes and reboots
- Action movies and thrillers
- Focus Features releases
- David Cronenberg films
- Jason Statham projects
- Paul W.S. Anderson productions
- IMAX releases and partnerships
- Movie posters and promotional materials
- Independent and studio films
- Director and actor profiles
- Film festival coverage
- Production updates and deals

## Home & Main Pages

- [FirstShowing.net](http://host.firstshowing.net/): Homepage featuring latest movie trailers, reviews, and film news

## Movie News & Production Updates

- [Universal & Legendary Sign New Deal with IMAX for 'Warcraft' & More](https://www.firstshowing.net/2014/universal-legendary-sign-new-deal-with-imax-for-warcraft-more/): Universal & Legendary Pictures announce 15-film IMAX deal through 2017
- [Ethan's Film Professor Sets Up Time Travel Thriller at Focus Features](https://www.firstshowing.net/2013/ethans-film-professor-sets-up-time-travel-thriller-at-focus-features/): Jason Doty sells time travel thriller Deprivation to Focus Features
